sections.title: The Epstein Relationship and Television Production
sections.content:
The documented relationship between Kuhn and Epstein began in late 2016. On September 28, 2016, Lesley Groff confirmed to Epstein that "Robert Kuhn is confirmed to come see you at 2pm on Oct. 7th" (EFTA02348271). Over the next 32 months, Kuhn visited Epstein at 9 East 71st Street at least 15 times: October 7, 2016 (2pm); February 9, 2017 (4pm); June 15, 2017 (9am breakfast); multiple attempts in July-August 2017; November 29, 2017 (2pm); January 5, 2018 (11am); April 2018 (during Kuhn's visit to New York for his mother's funeral); December 1, 2018 (noon); January 9, 2019 (11am); April 6, 2019 (11am, followed by a noon meeting with Gregory Chaitin); and June 13, 2019 (4pm). Kuhn and Epstein also communicated via Skype and FaceTime between visits.

Kuhn proposed two television series to Epstein. The first, The Science of Sleep and Dreams, was a 13-episode concept for approximately 200 PBS stations, proposed in January 2017 with a detailed budget and schedule. The proposal filename referenced the "Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation." The second and ultimately funded project was Radical Breakthroughs, a 13-episode series (selected from 15 proposed episodes) on mathematics, consciousness, emergence, evolutionary dynamics, predictive brains, and music cognition. Epstein exercised creative control over the series: he selected which episodes to produce, directed Kuhn to "cut 11 12 and 13" and "add antibiotics and their cognitive impacts" (EFTA02536749), requested video links for every potential participant, and reviewed preproduction books in detail. One episode was explicitly titled "Evolutionary Dynamics — Epstein program at Harvard," referencing the Martin Nowak program that Epstein funded (EFTA02536174). After a June 15, 2017 breakfast meeting, Kuhn wrote to Epstein: "A delight, as always — multiple fronts. Pleased to be your partner: 'Radical Breakthroughs' can be important; I take the responsibility — creative/content and business/financial — very seriously" (EFTA02646997).

Kuhn served as what can be characterized as an intellectual broker for Epstein, arranging introductions to leading scientists. On April 6, 2019, Kuhn organized a meeting at 9 East 71st Street between Epstein and mathematician Gregory Chaitin, a pioneer of algorithmic information theory. Kuhn arrived early at 11am to discuss "private matters" before Chaitin, his philosopher wife, their 18-month-old child, and producer Peter Getzels joined at noon (EFTA02282777). In December 2017, Kuhn referenced mathematician Misha Gromov (Abel Prize laureate) in the preproduction materials, and both Kuhn and Gromov visited Epstein on the same days: November 29, 2017 (Gromov at 1pm, Kuhn at 4:45pm) and December 1, 2018 (Gromov at 10am, Kuhn at noon). The December 1, 2018 gathering was a full science salon, with Richard Axel (Nobel laureate in neuroscience, 2004) also scheduled that day alongside Vincenzo Iozzo and Kathryn Ruemmler (EFTA02263313). In May 2019, Kuhn traveled to Boston to interview Martin Nowak for the series — a researcher whose Harvard program Epstein had separately funded. This pattern of connecting Epstein with Nobel laureates and leading mathematicians parallels the roles played by John Brockman's Edge Foundation and Nowak's Program for Evolutionary Dynamics in Epstein's science patronage network.

sections.title: Funding Mechanism and Financial Flows
sections.content:
The financial infrastructure for the Kuhn-Epstein arrangement was established in February 2017, when Kuhn emailed Epstein's assistant the Kuhn Foundation's IRS tax-exempt determination letter, describing it as a "501(c)(3) — private operating foundation — The Kuhn Foundation, which I set up in 1999 to support Closer To Truth" (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_025190). Kuhn then opened a dedicated sub-account within his foundation labeled "Kuhn Foundation CTT JE — Radical Breakthroughs" to "facilitate monitoring use of funds" (EFTA02580751). This architecture provided a tax-deductible receiving vehicle for grants from Gratitude America while segregating the Epstein-related money within the foundation's accounts.

The first grant of $150,000 was wired on August 1, 2017 from Gratitude America, processed by Richard Kahn of HBRK Associates at 575 Lexington Avenue, New York. On June 14, 2018, Epstein emailed Kahn: "robert kuhn we need to send 600k from foundation. remind me torow" (EFTA02581174). The following day, Kahn confirmed the prior $150,000 payment and offered to "send 600k today," asking whether Darren Indyke needed to draft paperwork (EFTA02580751). The IRS 990 filing for Gratitude America records only $500,000 for 2018, creating a $100,000 discrepancy with the $600,000 Epstein directed — it is unclear whether the amount was reduced before transmission, split across tax years, or recorded differently. The confirmed total from 990 filings is $650,000 ($150,000 in 2017 and $500,000 in 2018), making the Kuhn Foundation the second-largest cumulative Gratitude America recipient after the International Peace Institute at $525,000.

The ultimate source of these funds traces to Leon Black, co-founder of Apollo Global Management, whose BV70 LLC capitalized Gratitude America with $10,003,000 in October 2015. Epstein had committed a total of $1.4 million for the Radical Breakthroughs project; only $650,000 was delivered before his arrest. A March 2019 email thread references Kuhn needing to "optimize for JEVI Foundation as well as CTT" (EFTA02636358), suggesting that in addition to Gratitude America, the Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation (JEVI) may have been contemplated as a second funding channel. CNBC reported in December 2019 that the project lacked funding after Epstein's death, confirming the remaining $750,000 commitment was never fulfilled.

The Kuhn Foundation itself (EIN 33-0783933) is a substantial entity, holding approximately $8–11 million in assets between 2011 and 2024, with annual expenses of $1–2.2 million. It is run entirely by the Kuhn family: Robert Kuhn as President (25 hours per week), Dora Kuhn as Vice President, Aaron Kuhn (New York) as Vice President, Adam Kuhn as CFO, and Daniella Kuhn as Secretary — all at zero compensation. The foundation is registered at 357 Waverly Drive, Pasadena, California, and its sole program activity is Closer to Truth. No litigation, FARA registration, lobbying filings, or SEC filings have been identified for either Kuhn or the foundation.

sections.title: China Access and Geopolitical Intelligence
sections.content:
Kuhn's relationship with Epstein extended well beyond the television project. As one of the most connected Western figures in Chinese government circles — author of The Man Who Changed China (the authorized Jiang Zemin biography), host of CGTN state television, and recipient of Xi Jinping's 2018 China Reform Friendship Medal — Kuhn possessed geopolitical access of considerable intelligence value. The email record shows he regularly shared this access with Epstein.

In January 2017, immediately upon arriving in New York, Kuhn wrote to Epstein: "Just got to New York — love to meet, brainstorm. From Washington, my inauguration-day commentary and conversation with Chinese experts on Sino-US" relations under the incoming Trump administration, noting he was doing CNBC on Trump-China policy (EFTA02661882). In March 2017, Kuhn disclosed to Epstein that he had just returned from a month in China where he had moderated Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's discussion with leading Chinese technologists — including Baidu CEO Robin Li — "at the request of the governments of China and Israel" for the 25th anniversary of diplomatic relations (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_025105). This single disclosure confirms Kuhn operated as an intermediary at the highest levels of China-Israel state relations.

In March 2018, writing from Beijing, Kuhn updated Epstein on Xi Jinping's abolition of presidential term limits, noting he was providing commentary on CNN Amanpour and Bloomberg. He added: "Also Saudi stuff — which we should discuss" (EFTA02508836). Epstein, in turn, referenced Kuhn "winning your long-odds bet on Trump with Woody" (Allen), indicating their discussions encompassed U.S. domestic politics and that both men moved in overlapping social circles (EFTA02662499). Kuhn explicitly told Epstein that their private communications extended beyond the television project: "Obviously, whenever we need to communicate privately about Radical Breakthroughs just email, Skype or meet. Also on other stuff, too" (EFTA02503880). He proposed "private, pick-me-up Skype/FaceTime on geopolitics" and framed their discussions of U.S.-China-Middle East politics as enjoyable — "our kind of gossip" (EFTA02254986). Kuhn regularly commuted between Beijing, Santa Monica, and New York, often reporting to Epstein upon arrival from China with fresh geopolitical intelligence.

This pattern is consistent with Epstein's documented practice of cultivating individuals with direct access to foreign government leaders. Kuhn's value to Epstein lay not merely in his television credentials but in his unique position as a trusted interlocutor of the Chinese Communist Party leadership who simultaneously maintained Western media credibility through BBC, CNN, Bloomberg, Fox Business, and CNBC appearances. Whether Epstein leveraged this intelligence commercially, passed it to third parties, or simply valued it as social currency remains an open question.

sections.title: Reputational Risk Management and the PBS Shield
sections.content:
A March 2019 email thread reveals that both Kuhn and Epstein were acutely aware of the reputational risks their association carried. Kuhn was managing which scientists being filmed for Closer to Truth could safely be introduced to Epstein. He assessed the "level of risk" for each potential contact, recommending that Epstein meet Gregory Chaitin (who lived in Brazil and posed "low risk") but not Danny Chamovitz, the new president of Ben Gurion University of the Negev, who "might be nervous." Kuhn explicitly worried that someone "could try to make a problem with PBS" (EFTA02636272).

Epstein's response is revealing: "i have no ego or interest in public jevi or anything associated with me I only like to listen to ideas one on one and talk to the guys you now thinik are super smart. thats all" (EFTA02636343). The statement simultaneously acknowledges that his name was toxic, insists on maintaining one-on-one access to elite scientists, and uses "JEVI" as a self-reference — confirming the Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation brand as personally identified with Epstein. Despite this awareness, Kuhn continued the relationship: the final confirmed meeting was scheduled for June 13, 2019 at 4pm, and Kuhn was planning filming in New York for June 2-4, 2019 (EFTA02285644). The relationship persisted until Epstein's arrest on July 6, 2019.

The PBS brand functioned as a critical element in this arrangement. A post-2008 convicted sex offender could not directly produce a public television series, but through Kuhn and his foundation's longstanding PBS relationship, Epstein could exercise creative control, select participants, and shape episode content without his name appearing in credits. The series proposal filename referenced the "Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation," but Kuhn deliberately kept the sponsorship secret from PBS. Kuhn's established credibility — his decades-long Closer to Truth track record, his China advisory role, his neuroscience PhD — provided the narrative shield that made the arrangement viable. For Epstein, it offered a path to continued access to the scientific elite and the reputational rehabilitation that association with PBS-quality content could provide.

A separate scheduling note reads "friday mooch ruemmler bannon. sat kuhn" (EFTA02279971), placing Kuhn in the same weekly rotation as Anthony Scaramucci, the former Obama White House counsel, and Bannon. On April 26, 2018, Kuhn's meeting was scheduled alongside a Bannon dinner the previous evening and a dinner with Woody Allen (EFTA02244753).

That Saturday featured: Misha Gromov at 10am, Kuhn at noon, Vincenzo Iozzo at 12:30pm, a visit to Kathryn Ruemmler's new apartment on Mott Street at 2pm, and Richard Axel at 5pm (EFTA02263313).
